notes: Regional threats and usurpers for the political layer (design §6). Strength 1–6 is set against the owning kingdom's garrison to give a threat level of 0–3.

entries.name: Orc warband
entries.description: Clans united under one war-chief, raiding the valleys below their holds.

entries.name: Goblin raiders
entries.description: Many small bands that strike at night and vanish into the trees.

entries.name: Restless dead
entries.description: Old graves and battlefields that no longer stay quiet.

entries.name: Dark cult
entries.description: A secret faith in the towns, with friends in the council and something in the cellar.

entries.name: Bandit lord
entries.description: An outlaw who taxes the roads and calls it protection.

entries.name: Pretender to the throne
entries.description: A rival claimant with a banner, a grievance and a growing host.

entries.name: Hag coven
entries.description: Three old women whose bargains always cost more than they say.

entries.name: Drake brood
entries.description: Young drakes that have claimed the high places and the herds below them.

entries.name: Giant clan
entries.description: A family of giants who treat the lowlands as a larder.

entries.name: Serpent cult
entries.description: Masked worshippers who trade in venom, secrets and people.
